songwriter.line: What would it sound like if you were the songwriter
stanza: What would it sound like if you were the songwriter
And you made your living off of me?
Would you detail your near-constant consternation
With the way my very presence makes your muses up and flee?

typewriter.line: Now I'm hunched over a typewriter
stanza: Now I'm hunched over a typewriter
I guess you call that painting in a cave
And there's a word I can't remember
And a feeling I cannot escape
I'm still staring at a clean white page
Oh and morning's at my window
She is sending me to bed again
